chunks: He said: "I would like to marry one of these two daughters of mine to you if you agree to work for me on hire for eight years. And if you stay on for ten, it is up to you. I do not wish to impose any hardship on you. God willing you will find me a man of honour."

key_terms.أُنْکِحَکَ: I will marry you (to my daughter)
key_terms.تَأْجُرَنِي: You will hire yourself to me / work for me
key_terms.حِجَجٍ: Years (specifically in the context of service)

ai.seo_question: What was the marriage proposal made by Prophet Shu'ayb to Prophet Musa?
ai.summary: In this verse, Prophet Shu'ayb (AS) proposes a conditional marriage contract (Muhar) to Musa (AS), specifying eight years of service with an optional two-year extension at Musa's discretion, emphasizing flexibility and lack of burden. Shia scholars highlight this as a precedent for contractual marriage terms and the virtue of voluntary labor, noting Shu'ayb’s assurance of Musa’s righteousness as a sign of divine selection. The narrative underscores the integration of spiritual merit with practical social arrangements in prophetic traditions.
